Hi! Yes, I have the notes. For shift_weekly, it was agreed that every entry in the result must lie within a single day (end <= 1440) because room calendars cannot store overnight entries. If a shift crosses midnight, it should be split into two entries, with the second starting at 0 on the following day (Sunday wraps to Monday).

Hi! On SLOTPLAN-108 (intersect_intervals) - could you share the edge-case decisions from the design review? Specifically: are intervals half-open [start,end)? What about touching intervals (e.g. [1,3] vs [3,5]) - empty intersection? And are zero-length intervals dropped? I want to make sure the existing impl matches before I merge.

Hi! Yes, I have the notes. For rest_violations: 'Because the rota repeats, the rest after a worker's last shift of the week runs into their first shift of the following week (e.g. Sunday evening to Monday morning) and has to be checked as well.' Hope that helps!
